description: Carry all your essential gear and supplies while on the go with Rothco’s Canvas Paratrooper Bag. Measuring 15 inch x 11 inch x 4 inch, this versatile bag is large enough to fit most laptops, and other supplies, making it ideal for daily use, work, or travel. The bag features a 3-divider section that keeps all your gear organized and easily accessible. A large flap closure with a metal clip ensures your contents remain secure during transit. Constructed from heavyweight unwashed cotton canvas, this messenger bag is designed for durability and longevity. An outer snap compartment features two rows of nine shell loops, providing storage for writing utensils or other small items. The adjustable shoulder strap extends to 41 inches, allowing you to carry the bag comfortably over your shoulder. The front of the bag proudly displays a red parawing symbol, adding a touch of distinctive style to this practical accessory. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
